value.rationale: The exact minimum number of nonzero outcomes of three complementary measurements is a natural intermediate uncertainty invariant. The 2022 primary paper explicitly identifies sharp triple bounds as future work. The theorem resolves this in the first two nontrivial primes p=5 and 7, improving 9 to 10 and 12 to 14, and gives complete all-triples certificates rather than a sample or isolated numerical witness.
